Pri vate keys for NIST and Brainpool ECC curves are provided with their X and Y coordinates and an additional scalar: ECC Private Key = Point X | Point Y | Scalar. The points and the scalar are stored in little endian format. Example: Brainpool curve P(25 6) = X(32) | Y(32) | SCALAR(32)
The public key information for ED25519 contains a point on the curve: ED25519 Public Key = Point X The point is stored in little endian format. Example: ED25519 Public Key = X(32).

The private key information for ED25519 contains a random constant and the point X on the curve: ED25519 Private Key = Seed K | Point X The point and the seed are stored in little endian format. Example: ED25519 Private Key = Seed K(32) | X(32).
